/* Nearby hosted-race list preview. Observation and local choices only.
 * This module cannot send game input, join a lobby, control AI or fetch data.
 * Source: web/src/app/lobby.ts and runtime/roam_game.c at upstream 16b2386.
 * A visible name is a display criterion, not a verified player/lobby identity. */
(function (root) {
  'use strict';
  const MAX_ROWS = 32, MAX_SELECTED = 16, FRESH_MS = 2500;
  function text(value, max = 180) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim() || value.length > max || /[\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]/.test(value)) return null;
    return value.trim();
  }
  function descriptor(value) {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return null;
    const host = text(value.host, 128), kind = text(value.kind, 64), where = text(value.where);
    if (!host || !kind || !where) return null;
    return Object.freeze({ host, kind, where, key: JSON.stringify([host, kind, where]) });
  }
  // Only read what the regular nearby-lobby card displays. Do not inspect
  // friends, chat, sockets, account data or the native input/output rings.
  function capture(doc) {
    const panels = doc.querySelectorAll('#lobby'), covers = doc.querySelectorAll('#lobby-cover');
    if (panels.length !== 1 || covers.length !== 1) return { state: 'unknown' };
    const visible = el => !el.hidden && typeof el.getClientRects === 'function' && el.getClientRects().length > 0 &&
      (typeof el.checkVisibility !== 'function' || el.checkVisibility({ visibilityProperty: true, opacityProperty: true, checkVisibilityCSS: true, checkOpacity: true }));
    const panel = panels[0];
    if (visible(covers[0])) return { state: 'trip' };
    if (!visible(panel)) return { state: 'none' };
    const state = panel.dataset.v;
    if (['spot', 'note', 'lobby'].includes(state)) return { state };
    if (state !== 'join') return { state: 'unknown' };
    const head = panel.firstElementChild, players = panel.querySelectorAll('.lobby-players');
    if (!head || players.length !== 1) return { state: 'unknown' };
    const titles = head.querySelectorAll('.lobby-race'), first = players[0].firstElementChild;
    const hosts = first?.querySelectorAll('.lobby-pname');
    const where = head.children[1];
    if (titles.length !== 1 || !hosts || hosts.length !== 1 || !where?.classList.contains('ov-small') || where.querySelector('.lobby-star')) return { state: 'unknown' };
    const race = descriptor({ host: hosts[0].textContent, kind: titles[0].textContent, where: where.textContent });
    return race ? { state: 'join', race } : { state: 'unknown' };
  }
  class Choices {
    constructor() { this.rows = new Map(); this.selected = new Set(); this.watching = false; this.current = { state: 'none' }; this.time = null; this.reason = 'Off'; }
    observe(sample, now) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(now) || now < 0 || (this.time !== null && now < this.time)) { this.stop('Clock changed'); this.current = { state: 'unknown' }; return false; }
      this.time = now;
      const race = sample?.state === 'join' ? descriptor(sample.race) : null;
      this.current = race ? { state: 'join', race } : { state: ['none', 'trip', 'spot', 'note', 'lobby'].includes(sample?.state) ? sample.state : 'unknown' };
      if (race) {
        if (!this.rows.has(race.key) && this.rows.size >= MAX_ROWS) {
          const unselected = [...this.rows.values()].filter(r => !this.selected.has(r.key)).sort((a, b) => a.lastSeen - b.lastSeen);
          if (unselected[0]) this.rows.delete(unselected[0].key);
        }
        if (this.rows.has(race.key) || this.rows.size < MAX_ROWS) this.rows.set(race.key, { ...race, lastSeen: now });
      }
      return true;
    }
    choose(key, yes) {
      if (!this.rows.has(key)) return false;
      if (yes) { if (!this.selected.has(key) && this.selected.size >= MAX_SELECTED) return false; this.selected.add(key); }
      else this.selected.delete(key);
      if (!this.selected.size) this.stop('Select at least one observed race');
      return true;
    }
    start() { if (!this.selected.size) return false; this.watching = true; this.reason = ''; return true; }
    stop(reason = 'Stopped') { this.watching = false; this.reason = reason; }
    clear() { this.stop('Cleared'); this.rows.clear(); this.selected.clear(); this.current = { state: 'none' }; }
    view(now) {
      const fresh = this.time !== null && Number.isFinite(now) && now >= this.time && now - this.time <= FRESH_MS;
      const state = fresh ? this.current.state : 'unknown', key = state === 'join' ? this.current.race.key : '';
      let status = this.reason || 'Off';
      if (this.watching) status = state === 'join' && this.selected.has(key) ? 'Selected race visible. Join it manually in the game.'
        : state === 'trip' ? 'The game is handling a race transition. No input sent.'
        : state === 'lobby' ? 'A lobby is open. The game and host control its start.'
        : state === 'unknown' ? 'Waiting for a recognized nearby race card.' : 'Waiting for a selected nearby race card.';
      return { watching: this.watching, status, rows: [...this.rows.values()].map(r => ({ ...r, selected: this.selected.has(r.key), visible: fresh && key === r.key })) };
    }
  }
  function mount(doc, win, container = doc.documentElement) {
    if (container.querySelector('#nfsu2-hosted-list-preview')) return null;
    const model = new Choices(), host = doc.createElement('div'); host.id = 'nfsu2-hosted-list-preview'; host.dataset.nfsu2Ui = '';
    host.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:2147483646;max-width:360px';
    const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: 'closed' });
    const make = (tag, value) => { const e = doc.createElement(tag); if (value) e.textContent = value; return e; };
    const css = ':host{font:13px system-ui;color:#edf4ff}details{background:#142235;border:1px solid #596c85;border-radius:8px;padding:10px}summary,button,input{cursor:pointer}p{line-height:1.4;margin:8px 0}label{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #40516a}small{display:block;color:#a8bbd4}button{padding:6px;margin-right:6px}button:disabled{cursor:default}section{max-height:240px;overflow:auto}';
    const sheet = new win.CSSStyleSheet(); sheet.replaceSync(css); shadow.adoptedStyleSheets = [sheet];
    const panel = make('details'), title = make('summary', 'Hosted race list · preview');
    const help = make('p', 'Drive to a race start, then use the game’s next-lobby control to show each nearby card. Tick up to 16 races you want. Choices last for this page only.');
    const warning = make('p', 'Read-only preview: no automatic joining or driving. This is not the global Online list. Matching uses visible host and race text, not a verified player ID.');
    const list = make('section'), controls = make('p'), watch = make('button', 'Watch selected'), stop = make('button', 'Stop watching'), clear = make('button', 'Clear choices'), status = make('p');
    for (const button of [watch, stop, clear]) button.type = 'button';
    status.setAttribute('role', 'status'); controls.append(watch, stop, clear); panel.append(title, help, warning, list, controls, status); shadow.append(panel); container.append(host);
    let previous = '', destroyed = false, placeholder = null;
    const rowNodes = new Map();
    const render = () => {
      const state = model.view(win.performance.now()), encoded = JSON.stringify({ ...state, rows: state.rows.map(({ lastSeen, ...row }) => row) });
      if (encoded === previous) return; previous = encoded;
      watch.disabled = model.selected.size === 0 || state.watching; stop.disabled = !state.watching; status.textContent = state.status;
      const keys = new Set(state.rows.map(row => row.key));
      for (const [key, entry] of rowNodes) if (!keys.has(key)) { entry.label.remove(); rowNodes.delete(key); }
      if (state.rows.length && placeholder) { placeholder.remove(); placeholder = null; }
      for (const row of state.rows) {
        let entry = rowNodes.get(row.key);
        if (!entry) {
          const label = make('label'), check = make('input'), words = make('span', `${row.host} · ${row.kind}`), seen = make('small');
          check.type = 'checkbox'; check.setAttribute('aria-label', `Select ${row.host} ${row.kind} ${row.where}`);
          check.addEventListener('change', () => { model.choose(row.key, check.checked); previous = ''; render(); });
          words.append(make('small', row.where), seen); label.append(check, words); list.append(label);
          entry = { label, check, seen }; rowNodes.set(row.key, entry);
        }
        entry.check.checked = row.selected;
        entry.seen.textContent = row.visible ? 'Visible now' : 'Previously seen · may no longer be available';
      }
      if (!state.rows.length && !placeholder) { placeholder = make('p', 'No nearby race cards observed yet.'); list.append(placeholder); }
    };
    const poll = () => { if (destroyed) return; try { model.observe(capture(doc), win.performance.now()); } catch { model.observe({ state: 'unknown' }, win.performance.now()); } render(); };
    const halt = reason => { model.stop(reason); render(); };
    watch.addEventListener('click', () => { model.start(); render(); }); stop.addEventListener('click', () => halt('Stopped')); clear.addEventListener('click', () => { model.clear(); render(); });
    const key = e => { if (e.code === 'F7' || e.code === 'F9') halt('Stopped'); };
    const visibility = () => { if (doc.hidden) halt('Tab hidden'); };
    const blur = () => halt('Window unfocused');
    win.addEventListener('keydown', key, true); doc.addEventListener('visibilitychange', visibility); win.addEventListener('blur', blur);
    const timer = win.setInterval(poll, 1000); poll();
    return { stop() { halt('Stopped'); }, destroy() { destroyed = true; win.clearInterval(timer); win.removeEventListener('keydown', key, true); doc.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', visibility); win.removeEventListener('blur', blur); model.stop(); host.remove(); } };
  }
  const api = Object.freeze({ descriptor, capture, Choices, mount, MAX_ROWS, MAX_SELECTED, FRESH_MS });
  if (typeof module === 'object' && module.exports) module.exports = api;
  else root.__NFSU2_HOSTED_RACE_LIST__ = api;

      else if(choices.ai&&d.aiActive)driver=c.drag?'Native Drag AI active':'Native AI active';
      else if(choices.ai)driver=c.aiAvailable===false?'AI unavailable':c.aiStatus==='failed'?'AI handoff failed':c.aiStatus==='retry'?'AI needs off / on':'AI requested · waiting';
      else if(c.manual||d.driverKind===1)driver='Manual driver';
      else if(d.aiDriverVerified)driver='Native AI · not tool-owned';
      else driver='Driver unavailable';
    }
    const selected=c.roam?choices.aiPace:c.race?choices.racePace:false;
    const factor=c.roam?choices.paceFactor:c.race?choices.racePaceFactor:1;
    let pace=blocked?'Not confirmed':c.paceAvailable===false?'Unavailable on this build':c.drag||c.drift?'Native · custom pace paused':!c.roam&&!c.race?'Unavailable in this mode':!selected?'Native target':Number.isFinite(factor)?factor.toFixed(2)+'× selected':'Unavailable';
    if(live&&!blocked&&c.paceAvailable!==false&&!c.drag&&!c.drift&&(c.roam||c.race)) {
      const target=selected?factor:1;
      if(choices.ai&&Number.isFinite(target)) {
        // An older acknowledgement must not confirm a newly selected factor.
        const confirmed=d.paceConfirmed===true && !c.switching && Number.isFinite(d.paceApplied) && d.paceApplied>=.75 && d.paceApplied<=3 && Math.abs(d.paceApplied-target)<.011;
        pace=target.toFixed(2)+'× req · '+(confirmed?d.paceApplied.toFixed(2)+'× ack':'pending');
      } else if(selected&&Number.isFinite(factor))pace=factor.toFixed(2)+'× selected · AI off';
    }
    const req=choices.boost?choices.power:1;
    const requested=Number.isFinite(req)?req.toFixed(1)+'× req':'Requested';
    const states={'network-permission':'online paused',unsupported:'unavailable','not-ready':'waiting',hidden:'paused',unfocused:'paused',hud:'waiting','not-driving':'waiting',menu:'paused','drift-change':'waiting',layout:'unavailable',settling:'settling',suspended:'paused','tuner-busy':'tuner busy',neutral:'neutral',changed:'changed',rejected:'rejected'};
    let power=!(choices.boost||choices.unlimit)?'Off':requested+' · '+(blocked?'not confirmed':states[d.powerStatus]||'pending');
    if(!blocked&&d.powerStatus==='applied'&&d.powerActive===true&&Number.isFinite(d.effectivePower)&&d.effectivePower>=1&&d.effectivePower<=3&&Math.abs(d.effectivePower-req)<.011)power=requested+' · '+d.effectivePower.toFixed(1)+'× set';
    const limiter=!choices.unlimit?'':!blocked&&d.powerStatus==='applied'&&d.limiterRemoved===true?' · governor removed':' · governor requested';
    return {governor:limiter?limiter.slice(3):'',speed,unit:speed==='Unavailable'?'':'km/h',context,driver,pace,power,powerTitle:power+limiter+'. Set reports guarded power-field writes, not measured speed or horsepower.',state:paused||(d.network&&!choices.online?'Read-only · network tools paused':'Live observations'),speedTitle:speed==='Unavailable'?(paused||'Speed telemetry is unavailable for this build or car.'):'Native speed sample converted from m/s to km/h. Not a GPS or measured tuning gain.'};
  }
  function renderInfoHud() {
    if(!ui)return;
    const hud=ui.querySelector('#info-hud');
    hud.hidden=!infoHudEnabled||visible;
    ui.querySelector('#info-hud-enable').checked=infoHudEnabled;
    if(hud.hidden)return;
    const view=infoHudView(infoHudSample,prefs,performance.now());
    for(const field of ['speed','unit','context','driver','pace','power','governor','state']) {
      const node=ui.querySelector('#hud-'+field);
      if(node.textContent!==view[field])node.textContent=view[field];
      node.title=field==='speed'?view.speedTitle:field==='power'?view.powerTitle:view[field];
      if(field==='governor')node.hidden=!view.governor;
    }
  }
  function setInfoHud(enabled) {
    infoHudEnabled=!!enabled;
    try {sessionStorage.setItem(HUD_KEY,infoHudEnabled?'1':'0');} catch {}
    renderInfoHud();
  }
  function clearInfoHud(reason='Waiting for live sample') {
    infoHudSample=null;

    if(ui&&infoHudEnabled&&!visible)ui.querySelector('#hud-state').textContent=reason;
  }
  function renderPowerStatus(powerStatus,tune={}) {
    if(!ui)return;
    const powerText={off:'Off · not a vehicle-speed multiplier',unsupported:'Unavailable · game build not verified','not-ready':'Waiting for the current car','network-permission':'Paused online · enable Allow network tools',hidden:'Paused · tab hidden',unfocused:'Paused · game unfocused',hud:'Waiting for driving HUD','not-driving':'Waiting for active driving',menu:'Paused · game menu open','drift-change':'Waiting for drift handling change',layout:'Unavailable · car performance layout',settling:'Waiting for stable performance values',suspended:'Paused · waiting for driving tools to resume','tuner-busy':'Paused · tuner is busy',applied:`Power fields set to ${Number(tune.power).toFixed(1)}×${tune.unlimit?' · stock governor set to zero':''}`,neutral:'Neutral · 1.0× power',changed:'Waiting · native tuning/state changed',rejected:'Not applied · performance guard rejected'};
    ui.querySelector('#power-state').textContent=powerText[powerStatus];
    ui.querySelector('#power-state').title=(tune.reason||powerText[powerStatus])+'. This reports guarded field writes, not a measured speed increase.';

  function clearPaceEvidence() {
    // A stop request can precede native handback. Retain native ownership
    // diagnostics, but never present an old acknowledgement as a current one.
    diagnosticState={...diagnosticState,paceConfirmed:false,paceApplied:undefined};
    clearInfoHud();
    if(ui){
      ui.querySelector('#ai-pace-state').textContent=prefs.aiPace?'Waiting for current AI acknowledgement':'Off · free roam only';
      ui.querySelector('#race-pace-state').textContent=prefs.racePace?'Waiting for current AI acknowledgement':'Off · normal race pace';
    }
  }
  function clearApplicationEvidence(status='suspended') {
    // Reporting only. Actual restoration and native handback remain owned by
    // the existing callers, and are not claimed to have completed here.
    try {
      clearPaceEvidence();
      const powerStatus=prefs.boost||prefs.unlimit?status:'off';
      diagnosticState={...diagnosticState,powerStatus,powerActive:false,effectivePower:undefined,limiterRemoved:false};
      renderPowerStatus(powerStatus);
    } catch {}
  }
  function pendingCornerText(state) {
    // Existing read-only evidence only. Stages are the furthest native check
    // reached for this request, not a diagnosis of the latest turn or failure.
    // A missing hit does not prove the road has no qualifying bends.
    if (state.cornerHits > 0) return 'Armed · waiting for current settings confirmation';
    if (state.cornerRouteOwned === true && state.cornerPlannerCorners === 0) return 'Armed · native plan currently has no corner entries';
    if (state.cornerProbeStage === 6) return 'Armed · limiting curve seen; reduction not confirmed';
    if (state.cornerProbeStage === 5) return 'Armed · planner reached; no speed reduction recorded';
    if (state.cornerProbeStage >= 1 && state.cornerProbeStage <= 4) return 'Armed · native corner checks not yet complete';
    return 'Armed · no native corner reduction recorded';
  }
  function cornerEvidenceText(state) {
    const count = value => Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 40 ? value : 'unknown';
    const stage = Number.isInteger(state.cornerProbeStage) && state.cornerProbeStage >= 0 && state.cornerProbeStage <= 7 ? state.cornerProbeStage : 'unknown';
    const mask = Number.isInteger(state.cornerGuardMask) && state.cornerGuardMask >= 0 && state.cornerGuardMask <= 255 ? state.cornerGuardMask : null;
    const checks = [[1,'command/profile'],[2,'AI ownership'],[4,'game context'],[8,'race state'],[16,'drag/drift exclusion'],[32,'network permission'],[64,'driver identity'],[128,'private route']];
    const sampled = mask === null ? 'unknown' : mask ? checks.filter(([bit]) => mask & bit).map(([,name]) => name).join(', ') : 'none';
    return `Native route points: ${count(state.cornerRouteNodes)}; corner entries: ${count(state.cornerPlannerCorners)}. Furthest native check: ${stage}/7; 7 means a hit exists. Sampled unmet checks: ${sampled}. Counts/checks are snapshots, not a proven cause. Export a short crash log after several turns if no reduction is recorded.`;
  }
  const NativeWorker = window.Worker;
  // Observe only the known game worker; AI validates its patched module separately.
  window.Worker = new Proxy(NativeWorker, {
    construct(Target, args, NewTarget) {
      const worker = Reflect.construct(Target, args, NewTarget);
      let url; try { url = new URL(String(args[0]), location.href); } catch { return worker; }
      if (url.origin !== location.origin || url.pathname !== '/host/game-worker.js') return worker;
      const send = worker.postMessage;
      let bootSession=null;
      worker.postMessage = function (m, ...rest) {
        if (m && m.mod instanceof WebAssembly.Module && m.memory instanceof WebAssembly.Memory && Number.isSafeInteger(m.slot) && m.slot>=0) {
          if(m.slot===0){
          const verifiedProfile=AI?.getModuleProfile?.(m.mod)||null;
          if (!engine || engine.memory !== m.memory || activeModule!==m.mod || activeWorker!==worker || moduleProfile!==verifiedProfile) {
            // Release only the previous verified session before sending the new
            // module to its worker. A reused memory object is not an identity.
            if(engine&&moduleProfile){try{const state=engine.state();engine.restorePerformance(state);engine.restoreGrip(state);}catch{}}
            dyno?.cancel();wall?.stop();cars?.stop();ai?.stop();
            sessionGeneration++;activeWorker=worker;activeModule=m.mod;moduleProfile=verifiedProfile;refreshCompatibility();
            // A new module/worker/memory generation has no current native
            // observations yet. Do not carry prior application or ownership
            // evidence into its boot event or an immediate diagnostic export.
            diagnosticState={generation:sessionGeneration,revision:moduleProfile?.revision||'unknown',supported,ready:false,driving:false,safe:false,tools:diagnosticTools()};
            clearApplicationEvidence('not-ready');
            diagnosticIdentity=null;
            recordDiagnostic('game-boot',{generation:sessionGeneration,slot:m.slot,memoryMiB:m.memory.buffer.byteLength/1048576,revision:moduleProfile?.revision||'unknown',supported,tools:diagnosticTools()});
            const caps=moduleProfile?.capabilities;
            dyno=caps?.fullTuner && globalThis.__NFSU2_DYNO_FULL__?.Controller?new globalThis.__NFSU2_DYNO_FULL__.Controller(m.memory,true,moduleProfile.revision,{prepared:AI.getNativeEvaluator(m.mod),module:m.mod}):caps?.dyno && globalThis.__NFSU2_DYNO__?.Controller?new globalThis.__NFSU2_DYNO__.Controller(m.memory,true,moduleProfile.revision):null;dyno?.setEnabled(dynoEnabled);
            wall=caps?.walls && Walls?.Controller?new Walls.Controller(m.memory,true,moduleProfile.wall):null;
            cars=caps?.cars && Cars?.Controller?new Cars.Controller(m.memory,true,moduleProfile.cars):null;
            ai=AI?.Controller?new AI.Controller(m.memory,!!caps?.ai,caps):null;
            engine = new Engine(m.memory,moduleProfile?.statusCapacity); statusPtr = 0; inputPtr = 0; driftPending = null; driftNeedsReapply=typeof prefs.drift==='boolean'; powerGate.reset(); gripGate.reset();
          }
          }
          bootSession={module:m.mod,memory:m.memory,generation:activeModule===m.mod&&engine?.memory===m.memory?sessionGeneration:-1};
        }
        return Reflect.apply(send, this, [m, ...rest]);
      };
      const currentSession = () => !!bootSession && bootSession.generation===sessionGeneration && bootSession.module===activeModule && bootSession.memory===engine?.memory;
      worker.addEventListener('error', event => recordDiagnostic('worker-error',{sessionCurrent:currentSession(),error:event.error || event.message,tools:diagnosticTools()}));
      worker.addEventListener('message', event => {
        const m = event.data;
        if(m?.t==='trap')recordDiagnostic('game-trap',{sessionCurrent:currentSession(),tid:m.tid,error:m.msg,stack:m.stack,tools:diagnosticTools()});
        if(m?.t==='exit')recordDiagnostic('game-exit',{sessionCurrent:currentSession(),code:m.code,tools:diagnosticTools()});
        if(!currentSession())return;
        if(m?.t==='register' && (m.kind===3||m.kind===5))recordDiagnostic('game-register',{kind:m.kind});
        if (worker===activeWorker && m?.t === 'register' && m.kind === 3 && Number.isSafeInteger(m.ptr)) inputPtr = m.ptr;
        if (worker===activeWorker && m?.t === 'register' && m.kind === 5 && Number.isSafeInteger(m.ptr)) statusPtr = m.ptr;
        if (m?.t === 'exit' || m?.t === 'trap') {suspend('Game stopped. Enabled choices are kept for the next game.');ai=null;wall=null;cars=null;dyno=null;engine=null;activeWorker=null;activeModule=null;moduleProfile=null;refreshCompatibility();statusPtr=0;inputPtr=0;}
      });
      return worker;
    }
  });
  // A different game revision must be reviewed before writing its memory.
  fetch('/game.json', { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'omit' }).then(r => {
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Build information unavailable');
    return r.json();
  }).then(info => {
    revision = String(info.rev || 'unknown');refreshCompatibility();
    recordDiagnostic('build',{revision,supported});
    if (!supported) message('Waiting for an exact verified game module. Unknown builds stay disabled.');
  }).catch(error => {recordDiagnostic('build-error',{error});message('Could not check game version. Memory tools stay disabled.');});

  function key(code, down) {
    const keyName = { ArrowUp: 'ArrowUp', ShiftLeft: 'Shift', AltLeft: 'Alt' }[code] || code;
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(down ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code, key: keyName,
      location: /Left$/.test(code) ? 1 : 0, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
  }
  function hold(code, down) {
    if (down && !held.has(code)) { if (!physicallyHeld.has(code)) { held.add(code); key(code, true); } }
    else if (!down && held.delete(code) && !physicallyHeld.has(code)) key(code, false);
  }
  function release() { clearTimeout(shiftTimer); for (const code of [...held]) hold(code, false); }
  function suspend(why) {
    dyno?.cancel();
    wall?.stop();cars?.stop(); ai?.stop(); release(); powerGate.reset(); gripGate.reset();
    try {if(engine){const state=engine.state();engine.restorePerformance(state);engine.restoreGrip(state);}} catch { /* no stale pointer writes */ }
    clearApplicationEvidence();
    if(why) message(why);
  }
  function stop(why = 'Driving controls off. F9 cleared driving assists and network permission. Saved profiles are kept. Load one manually, or select it and enable Load on startup to resume.', persistProfilePause=true) {
    try { hostedList?.stop(); } catch {}
    profileStartup=null;loadedProfile=null;profileActionEpoch++;profileActionPending=false;if(profileDriftChoice)driftNeedsReapply=false;profileDriftChoice=false;
    // Keep an already-issued drift request pending until confirmation/timeout: a
    // native toggle cannot be recalled safely, and a second must not overlap it.
    if(persistProfilePause){
      profileSessionStopped=true;
      try{sessionStorage.setItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP,'1');}catch{}
      const result=profileStore?.pause();
      profileNotice=result?.error||'Automatic loading paused by Stop. Select a profile and enable Load on startup to resume.';
      renderProfiles();
    }
    recordDiagnostic('stop',{tools:diagnosticTools()});
    dynoEnabled=false;dyno?.setEnabled(false);if(ui)ui.querySelector('#dyno-enable').checked=false;
    prefs.raceCornerAssist=false;prefs.cornerAssist=false;prefs.racePace=false;prefs.walls=false;prefs.cars=false;prefs.traffic=false;prefs.players=false;prefs.online=false;prefs.ai=false;prefs.aiPace=false;prefs.nos=false;prefs.dragNoBlowout=false;prefs.drag=false;prefs.boost=false;prefs.unlimit=false;prefs.grip=false;savePrefs();suspend();
    if(ui) for(const id of ['race-corner-assist','corner-assist','race-pace','walls','cars','traffic','players','online','ai','ai-pace','nos','drag-no-blowout','drag','boost','unlimit','grip']) ui.querySelector('#'+id).checked=false;
    message(profileNotice&&persistProfilePause ? why+' '+profileNotice : why);
  }
  function takeControl() {
    try { hostedList?.stop(); } catch {}
    recordDiagnostic('manual',{tools:diagnosticTools()});
    prefs.ai=false; ai?.stop(); dragTakenOver=true; release(); savePrefs();
    try {clearPaceEvidence();} catch {}
    if(ui) {ui.querySelector('#ai').checked=false;ui.querySelector('#ai-state').textContent='Manual control · native AI off';}
    message('Returning control to you. Native AI is off on the next game frame. Toggle drag assist again if you want assisted throttle.');
  }
  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (!e.isTrusted) return;
    if(e.code==='Insert' && e.shiftKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.altKey && !e.metaKey){
      // Shift+Insert remains Paste in text/editable controls, including controls
      // inside a shadow root. Otherwise it mirrors the existing F8 menu action.
      const path=e.composedPath?.()||[e.target];
      const editingNode=node=>{
        for(let depth=0;node&&depth<32;depth++,node=node.parentElement){
          if(node.isContentEditable || node.getAttribute?.('role')==='textbox' || /^(TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(node.tagName) || (node.tagName==='INPUT' && !/^(button|checkbox|radio|range|submit|reset|color|file|image|hidden)$/.test(String(node.type||'').toLowerCase())))return true;
        }
        return false;
      };
      // Window's composedPath hides our closed shadow tree. Its retained
      // activeElement is required to preserve Paste in the profile-name field.
      const editing=[...path,ui?.activeElement,document.activeElement].some(editingNode);
      if(e.isComposing || e.defaultPrevented || editing)return;
      e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)setPanel(!visible);return;
    }
    // Range controls keep their native arrow/Space behavior without taking over the car.
    if(host && e.composedPath?.().includes(host) && !['F6','F7','F8','F9','Escape'].includes(e.code)) return;
    if(e.code==='F6'){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)setInfoHud(!infoHudEnabled);return;}
    physicallyHeld.add(e.code);
    if(e.code==='F7') {e.preventDefault();takeControl();}
    else if(prefs.ai && ['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','KeyW','KeyA','KeyS','KeyD','Space'].includes(e.code)) takeControl();
    if (e.code === 'F8') { e.preventDefault(); setPanel(!visible); }
    if (e.code === 'Escape' && visible) setPanel(false);
    if (e.code === 'F9') { e.preventDefault(); stop(); }
  }, true);
  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.isTrusted) physicallyHeld.delete(e.code); }, true);
  window.addEventListener('focus', () => recordDiagnostic('resume',{reason:'blur',tools:diagnosticTools()}));
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => { recordDiagnostic('pause',{reason:'blur',tools:diagnosticTools()}); physicallyHeld.clear(); suspend('Paused while unfocused. Enabled tools resume when you return to a supported driving mode.'); });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { recordDiagnostic(document.hidden?'pause':'resume',{reason:'hidden',hidden:document.hidden,tools:diagnosticTools()}); if (document.hidden) suspend('Paused while the tab is hidden. Your enabled choices are kept.'); });
  window.addEventListener('storage',event=>{
    if(!ToolProfiles||![null,ToolProfiles.KEY,ToolProfiles.STOP_KEY].includes(event.key))return;

    const changed=loadedProfile&&!after.data.profiles.some(p=>p.id===loadedProfile.id&&p.revision===loadedProfile.revision);

      profileSessionStopped=true;try{sessionStorage.setItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP,'1');}catch{}
    }
    profileSelection=null;profileNotice=after.error||'Profiles updated in another tab. Select a profile again; nothing was automatically loaded.';renderProfiles();
  });
  window.addEventListener('pageshow',event=>{

    // resumes. Do not auto-reload a profile or revive a retained controller.

  });
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { recordDiagnostic('page-hide',{reason:'page-hide',tools:diagnosticTools()});savePrefs(); suspend(); clearInterval(timer); });

  function setDrift(wanted) {
    if (driftPending) return false;
    const state = engine?.state(), counters = engine && statusPtr ? engine.status(statusPtr) : null;
    if (!supported || !state?.ready || !state.driving || state.network || !counters || (counters.drive & 3) !== 2 || !Number.isFinite(counters.drift) || document.hidden || document.querySelector('dialog[open]')) {
      message('Drift assist only works while driving solo free roam with the game menus closed.'); return false;
    }
    if (!!(counters.drift & 1) === wanted) return true;
    // Rebuilding the native drift setup must not inherit our power multiplier.
    engine.restorePerformance(state);engine.restoreGrip(state);powerGate.reset();gripGate.reset();
    if (!engine.driftTap(inputPtr)) { message('Drift request not sent: the game input mailbox is unavailable, inactive, typing, or full.'); return false; }
    driftPending = { wanted, until: performance.now() + 3000 };
    ui.querySelector('#drift').disabled = true;
    message('Drift request sent. Waiting for the game to confirm its handling state…');
    return true;
  }
  function moduleFailure() {
    const patch=AI?.patchState;
    if(moduleProfile || patch?.phase!=='unavailable')return '';
    const reported=/^[a-f0-9]{8,40}$/.test(revision)?` Site reports build ${revision}.`:'';
    const bytes=Number.isSafeInteger(patch.moduleBytes)?` Loaded module: ${patch.moduleBytes} bytes.`:'';
    const signatures=Number.isInteger(patch.signatureUnique)?` Fingerprints: ${patch.signatureUnique}/${patch.signatureTotal} unique matches; this does not approve an unknown build.`:'';
    return ['module-size','module-hash'].includes(patch.patchCode)
      ? `Game module is not verified.${reported}${bytes} A compatible Driving Tools update is required.${signatures}`
      : `Game module could not be prepared.${reported} Reload once. If it persists, export the diagnostic log.`;
  }
  function tick() {
    try {
      const patch=AI?.patchState,phase=patch?.phase || 'idle';
      const key=JSON.stringify([phase,patch?.revision,patch?.moduleBytes,patch?.moduleHash,patch?.patchCode,patch?.signatureReference,patch?.signatureUnique,patch?.signatureFailed,revision]);
      if(key!==diagnosticPatch){diagnosticPatch=key;recordDiagnostic('patch-state',{phase,revision:patch?.revision,reportedRevision:revision,candidateRevision:patch?.candidateRevision,moduleBytes:patch?.moduleBytes,moduleHash:patch?.moduleHash,patchCode:patch?.patchCode,signatureReference:patch?.signatureReference,signatureExact:patch?.signatureExact,signatureTotal:patch?.signatureTotal,signatureUnique:patch?.signatureUnique,signatureMissing:patch?.signatureMissing,signatureAmbiguous:patch?.signatureAmbiguous,signatureFailed:patch?.signatureFailed,error:phase==='unavailable'?patch?.reason:undefined});}
      if(ui){const status=diagnostics?.status();ui.querySelector('#diagnostic-state').textContent=status?`${status.events} recent events · ${status.persistence==='same-tab'?'kept across reloads in this tab':'memory only; storage unavailable'}`:'Logger unavailable';if(status&&Number.isInteger(patch?.signatureUnique))ui.querySelector('#diagnostic-state').textContent+=` · fingerprints ${patch.signatureUnique}/${patch.signatureTotal}`;}
    } catch {}
    updateDynoUI();
    if(dyno?.busy) {clearApplicationEvidence('tuner-busy');clearInfoHud('Tuner busy · driving tools paused');try{diagnostics?.snapshot({...diagnosticState,dynoBusy:true,tools:diagnosticTools()});}catch{} wall?.stop();cars?.stop();ai?.stop();release();return;}
    if (!engine) { clearApplicationEvidence('not-ready');if (live) live.textContent = 'Waiting for game. Reload after installing, then press Play.'; return; }
    try {
      const s = engine.state(), counters = statusPtr ? engine.status(statusPtr) : null;
      dragRace=!!(s.ready && s.drag);
      const driveStatus = counters && Number.isFinite(counters.drive) ? counters.drive & 3 : 0;
      const canInput = supported && s.ready && (!s.network || prefs.online) && driveStatus !== 0 && !document.hidden && document.hasFocus() && !document.querySelector('dialog[open]');
      const safe = canInput && s.driving;
      // Record identity changes as booleans, never addresses or save/player identifiers.
      try {
      const identity={player:engine.u32(0xd00000),car:s.car,race:s.race};
      diagnosticState={generation:sessionGeneration,revision,supported,ready:!!s.ready,driving:!!s.driving,network:!!s.network,safe:!!safe,hidden:document.hidden,focused:document.hasFocus(),hud:driveStatus,flow:engine.u32(0x8654a4),gameTicks:engine.u32(0x86518c),raceType:engine.u32(0x89e7b0),racePhase:s.ready?engine.u32(s.race):0,driverKind:s.ready?engine.u32(s.car+0x24):0,physicsKind:s.ready?engine.u32(s.car+0x28):0,dynoBusy:!!dyno?.busy,tools:diagnosticTools()};
      if(diagnosticIdentity && Object.keys(identity).some(key=>identity[key]!==diagnosticIdentity[key]))recordDiagnostic('identity-change',{playerChanged:identity.player!==diagnosticIdentity.player,carChanged:identity.car!==diagnosticIdentity.car,raceChanged:identity.race!==diagnosticIdentity.race});
      diagnosticIdentity=identity;
      } catch {}
      const nativeRaceType=s.ready?engine.u32(0x89e7b0):null;
      const roamProfile=!dragRace && driveStatus===2 && nativeRaceType===0;
      const raceProfile=!dragRace && (nativeRaceType===1 || nativeRaceType===7);
      const roadRaceProfile=(!s.network || prefs.online) && !dragRace && driveStatus===1 && nativeRaceType===1 && !engine.u8(0x89e7d8) && !engine.u8(0x89e7d9) && !engine.u32(0x890108) && !engine.u32(0x890104) && !engine.u32(0x890114);

  function setPanel(open) {
    visible=!!open;
    if(host)host.style.width=visible?'244px':'170px';
    if(!visible && dyno?.busy)dyno.cancel();
    if(!ui) return;
    ui.querySelector('#tools-panel').hidden=!visible;
    ui.querySelector('#min').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(visible));
    ui.querySelector('#chevron').textContent=visible ? '▴' : '▾';
    renderInfoHud();
  }
  function updateDynoUI() {
    if(!ui)return;
    const busy=!!dyno?.busy,ready=!!(dynoEnabled && supported && dyno?.canUse() && !document.hidden && document.hasFocus());
    const context=ready&&!busy?dyno?.syncContext?.():null;
    if(context?.invalidated)dynoText='Car tuning or installed parts changed. Load settings or find a new tune for this game mode.';
    else if(context?.changed)dynoText=dyno.applied?'Applied tune found for this car and mode. Restore is available while it stays unchanged.':dyno.outcome?'Preview found for this car and mode. Review it before Apply.':'Ready for the selected mode. Load all settings or search a measured native estimate.';
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-mode').textContent=context?`Game tuning slot ${context.kind+1} of 5${Tune?.MODE_LABELS?.[context.kind]?' · '+Tune.MODE_LABELS[context.kind]:''} · selected in Mode Select`:busy&&dyno?.context?`Game tuning slot ${dyno.context.kind+1} of 5`:'Choose a race mode in the game, then open the Dyno main screen.';
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-find').disabled=!ready || busy || !!dyno?.applied;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-cancel').disabled=!busy;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-apply').disabled=!ready || busy || !(dyno?.full?dyno.outcome?.changed:dyno?.outcome?.improved) || !!dyno?.applied;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-restore').disabled=!ready || busy || !dyno?.applied;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').disabled=busy;
    for(const option of ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').options||[])if(['acceleration60','acceleration100','topSpeed'].includes(option.value))option.disabled=!dyno?.full;
    if(dyno && !dyno.full&&['acceleration60','acceleration100','topSpeed'].includes(ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value))ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value='peakPower';
    updateSetupEditor(ready,busy);
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-state').textContent=moduleFailure()?`Dyno unavailable. ${moduleFailure()}`:moduleProfile&&!moduleProfile.capabilities.dyno?'Not yet verified for this build':dynoText;
  }
  const tuneValue=value=>(value>100?'+':'')+(value-100);
  function updateSetupEditor(ready,busy){
    const editor=dyno?.editor,editable=!!(ready&&!busy&&editor&&!dyno?.applied);
    ui.querySelector('#tune-load').disabled=!ready||busy||!!dyno?.applied||!dyno?.full;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-preview').disabled=!editable;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-reset').disabled=!editable;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-group').disabled=!editable;
    const group=Tune?.GROUPS?.find(g=>g.id===ui.querySelector('#tune-group').value)||Tune?.GROUPS?.[0];
    for(let i=0;i<9;i++){
      const offset=group?.offsets[i],present=!!editor&&offset!==undefined,row=ui.querySelector('#tune-row-'+i),input=ui.querySelector('#tune-input-'+i);
      row.hidden=!present;input.disabled=!editable||!editor?.allowedOffsets.includes(offset);
      if(present){
        input.dataset.offset=String(offset);input.value=editor.draft[offset]-100;
        ui.querySelector('#tune-label-'+i).textContent=(Tune?.FIELD_LABELS?.[offset]||'Setting '+(offset+1))+(editor.allowedOffsets.includes(offset)?'':editor.unlockedOffsets?.includes(offset)?' · unverified':' · locked');
        ui.querySelector('#tune-value-'+i).textContent=tuneValue(editor.draft[offset]);
      }
    }
    const o=dyno?.outcome;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-changes').textContent=dyno?.full&&Array.isArray(o?.changes)?o.changes.map(x=>`${Tune?.FIELD_LABELS?.[x.offset]||x.field}: ${tuneValue(x.before)} → ${tuneValue(x.after)}${x.adjusted?' (native adjusted request '+tuneValue(x.requested)+')':''}`).join('\n')||'No accepted setup changes.':editor?'Edit sliders, then Preview changes. Drafts never alter the game.':'Load settings to see unlocked controls for this car and preset.';
  }
  async function runDyno(action) {
    if(!dynoEnabled || !dyno || dyno.busy)return;
    recordDiagnostic('dyno-action',{reason:action,tools:diagnosticTools()});
    suspend();
    dyno.setEnabled(true);
    try {
      if(action==='load'){
        await dyno.loadSetup();dynoText='All supported settings loaded. Edit a category, then Preview. Nothing changes in the game until Stage.';
      } else if(action==='preview'){
        const r=await dyno.preview();
        dynoText=`${r.changed?'Preview ready. Review accepted changes, then Stage selected preset.':'No accepted setup changes.'} Game unchanged. Native estimates: 0–60 ${r.bestResult.zeroTo60Seconds.toFixed(2)} s; 0–100 ${r.bestResult.zeroTo100Seconds.toFixed(2)} s; top ${(r.bestResult.topSpeedMps*3.6).toFixed(1)} km/h; ${r.bestResult.peakPowerKw.toFixed(1)} kW / ${r.bestResult.peakTorqueNm.toFixed(1)} Nm. NOS ${r.bestResult.nitrousSeconds.toFixed(2)} s / torque setting ${r.bestResult.nitrousTorque.toFixed(3)}. No handling/lap-time measurement.`;
      } else if(action==='find') {
        dynoText=dyno.full?'Searching in private memory · game setup stays unchanged':'Searching · original setup is restored after each trial';updateDynoUI();
        const r=await dyno.find({goal:ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value,onProgress:p=>{dynoText=`Searching ${p.evaluations}/${p.budget} trials · Cancel or F9 to stop`;updateDynoUI();}});
        const [field,unit]=({peakPower:['peakPowerKw','kW'],peakTorque:['peakTorqueNm','Nm'],acceleration60:['zeroTo60Seconds','s (0–60)'],acceleration100:['zeroTo100Seconds','s (0–100)'],topSpeed:['topSpeedMps','m/s']}[r.goal]);
        if(dyno.full){
          const manualSeed=r.seed?.some((value,index)=>value!==r.baseline[index]);
          const seedText=manualSeed&&r.changed?(r.improvedFromSeed?' Search improved the measured goal over your draft.':' No further measured improvement over the draft. Accepted manual draft retained.'):'';
          dynoText=`${r.baselineResult[field].toFixed(1)} → ${r.bestResult[field].toFixed(1)} ${unit} · ${r.evaluations} trials. Original kept. ${r.improved?'Measured goal improved versus original.':'No measured goal improvement versus original.'}${seedText} ${r.changed?'Review accepted changes, then Stage selected preset.':'No accepted setup changes.'} No handling/lap-time measurement.`;
        }else dynoText=`${r.baselineResult[field].toFixed(1)} → ${r.bestResult[field].toFixed(1)} ${unit} · ${r.evaluations} trials. Original kept. ${r.improved?'Stage preview to use this tune.':'No improvement found.'}`;
      } else if(action==='apply') {const r=await dyno.apply();dynoText=dyno.full?'Selected preset staged. Use the game’s Test Run to refresh driving physics, and Save Profile to persist. Disk save is not confirmed.'+(r.saveReady?'':' Other presets also have unsaved edits; native Save Profile saves them too.'):'Best tune applied. Use native Save Profile to persist.';}
      else {await dyno.restore();dynoText=dyno.full?'Previous current and selected-visit settings restored. Test Run refreshes physics. Save Profile again if you want this restored version persisted.':'Previous tune restored and confirmed.';}
    } catch(error) {recordDiagnostic('dyno-error',{error,dynoStatus:error?.dynoStatus,dynoGuard:error?.dynoGuard,dynoObserved:error?.dynoObserved,tools:diagnosticTools()});dynoText=error?.message || 'Dyno tuner stopped. Reload before retrying.';}
    updateDynoUI();
  }
  function exportDiagnostic() {
    if(!diagnostics){message('Diagnostic logger is unavailable. The game’s Download log may still have crash details.');return;}
    let url=null,link=null;
    try {
      recordDiagnostic('export',{tools:diagnosticTools()});
      const blob=new Blob([diagnostics.exportText()],{type:'application/json'});
      url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download='nfsu2-driving-tools-diagnostics.json';link.hidden=true;
      (document.body||document.documentElement).append(link);link.click();
      message('Diagnostic download requested. It stays local until you choose to share the file. For native crash details, also use the game’s Download log.');
    } catch(error) {recordDiagnostic('engine-error',{error});message('Diagnostic download failed. Try again, or use the game’s Download log.');}
    finally {link?.remove();if(url)setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);}
  }
  const profileToggleIds={raceCornerAssist:'race-corner-assist',cornerAssist:'corner-assist',racePace:'race-pace',walls:'walls',cars:'cars',traffic:'traffic',players:'players',online:'online',ai:'ai',aiPace:'ai-pace',nos:'nos',dragNoBlowout:'drag-no-blowout',drag:'drag',tester:'tester',boost:'boost',unlimit:'unlimit',grip:'grip'};
  const profileNumericBindings=[['race-corner-factor','raceCornerFactor','race-corner-value',2,'×'],['race-corner-margin','raceCornerMargin','race-corner-margin-value',0,'%'],['race-braking','raceBraking','race-braking-value',2,'×'],['race-pace-factor','racePaceFactor','race-pace-value',2,'×'],['corner-factor','cornerFactor','corner-value',2,'×'],['corner-margin','cornerMargin','corner-margin-value',0,'%'],['pace-factor','paceFactor','pace-value',2,'×'],['rpm','rpm','rpm-value',0,''],['power','power','power-value',1,'×'],['grip-factor','gripFactor','grip-value',1,'×']];
  function syncProfileControls(){
    if(!ui)return;
    for(const [key,id]of Object.entries(profileToggleIds))ui.querySelector('#'+id).checked=prefs[key];
    for(const [id,key,out,digits,suffix]of profileNumericBindings){const el=ui.querySelector('#'+id);el.value=prefs[key];ui.querySelector('#'+out).textContent=prefs[key].toFixed(digits)+suffix;el.setAttribute('aria-valuetext',prefs[key].toFixed(digits)+(suffix==='%'?' percent':suffix?' times':' RPM'));}
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-enable').checked=dynoEnabled;
    ui.querySelector('#drift').checked=!!prefs.drift;
    ui.querySelector('#hazards').hidden=!prefs.tester;
  }
  const profileLocks=()=>typeof navigator!=='undefined'&&navigator.locks&&typeof navigator.locks.request==='function'?navigator.locks:null;
  function renderProfiles(){
    if(!ui)return;
    const state=profileStore?.snapshot(),select=ui.querySelector('#profile-select');
    select.replaceChildren();const empty=document.createElement('option');empty.value='';empty.textContent='Choose a saved profile';select.append(empty);
    for(const p of state?.data.profiles||[]){const option=document.createElement('option');option.value=p.id;option.textContent=p.name;select.append(option);}
    const selected=state?.data.profiles.find(p=>p.id===profileSelection?.id&&p.revision===profileSelection?.revision);
    if(!selected){profileSelection=null;ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=false;}
    select.value=selected?.id||'';
    for(const id of ['profile-load','profile-update','profile-delete','profile-auto'])ui.querySelector('#'+id).disabled=profileActionPending||!state?.available||!selected||(id!=='profile-load'&&!profileLocks());
    ui.querySelector('#profile-save').disabled=profileActionPending||!state?.available||!profileLocks();
    for(const id of ['profile-select','profile-name','profile-network'])ui.querySelector('#'+id).disabled=profileActionPending;
    ui.querySelector('#profile-auto').checked=!!selected&&state.data.auto?.id===selected.id&&state.data.auto.stopToken===state.stopToken&&!profileSessionStopped;
    ui.querySelector('#profile-state').textContent=state?.error||(profileActionPending?'Waiting for another tab to finish saving profiles.':profileNotice)||(!profileLocks()?'Profile editing is unavailable because this browser cannot lock local saves.':!profileStore?'Profiles unavailable; existing controls still work.':state.paused?'Automatic loading paused by Stop. Select a profile and enable Load on startup to resume.':state.data.auto?'A saved profile will load on next startup.':'Automatic loading is off. Save current controls, then select and Load when needed.');
  }
  function selectProfile(){
    const id=ui.querySelector('#profile-select').value,state=profileStore?.refresh();
    profileSelection=state?.data.profiles.find(p=>p.id===id)||null;
    ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value=profileSelection?.name||'';
    ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=profileSelection?.networkConsent||false;
    profileNotice=profileSelection?'Selected '+profileSelection.name+'. Load applies its saved choices. Update replaces it with current controls.':'';renderProfiles();
  }
  function applyToolProfile(result,automatic=false){
    if(driftPending)throw Error('Wait for the current drift request to confirm or time out, then Load again. No profile was loaded.');
    if(dyno?.busy||dyno?.pending){dyno.cancel();throw Error('Tuner cancellation requested. Wait for the pending game request to finish, then Load again. A staged preset is not reverted.');}
    suspend();driftNeedsReapply=false;dragTakenOver=false;lastShift=0;lastPulse=0;
    const choices=result.settings;
    for(const key of Object.keys(prefs))prefs[key]=choices[key];
    dynoEnabled=choices.dynoEnabled;dyno?.setEnabled(dynoEnabled);
    if(ui){ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value=choices.dynoGoal;ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=result.profile.networkConsent;ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value=result.profile.name;}
    driftNeedsReapply=typeof prefs.drift==='boolean';profileDriftChoice=driftNeedsReapply;
    loadedProfile={id:result.profile.id,revision:result.profile.revision};savePrefs();syncProfileControls();
    dynoText=dynoEnabled?'Profile loaded. Open the solo Performance Tuning main screen. Existing staged presets are unchanged.':'Tuner off. Existing staged presets are unchanged.';updateDynoUI();
    profileNotice=(automatic?'Loaded on startup: ':'Loaded: ')+result.profile.name+'. Choices wait for verified game contexts.'+(result.profile.networkConsent?' Saved network permission restored where selected.':' Network permission and online no-clip remain off.')+' Game presets and drafts are not saved or restored by profiles.';
    message(profileNotice);renderProfiles();
  }
  function profileAction(action){
    if(profileActionPending)return;
    const request={stopToken:profileStore?.snapshot().stopToken,selection:profileSelection?{...profileSelection}:null,name:ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value,networkConsent:ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked===true,auto:ui.querySelector('#profile-auto').checked,settings:{...prefs,dynoEnabled,dynoGoal:ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value}};
    const epoch=profileActionEpoch;
    // localStorage has no atomic compare-and-swap. Serialize named-profile
    // writes across tabs with a browser-managed lock; Stop remains immediate
    // and its independent marker invalidates any stale startup authorization.
    const execute=()=>{
      if(epoch!==profileActionEpoch)return;
      if(action==='auto'){
        const latest=profileStore?.refresh();
        if(!latest?.available||latest.stopToken!==request.stopToken){profileNotice='Stop or profile storage changed while waiting. Select a profile and request startup loading again.';renderProfiles();return;}
      }
      performProfileAction(action,request);
    };
    if(action==='load'){execute();return;}
    const locks=profileLocks();
    if(!locks){profileNotice='Profile editing needs browser storage locking, which is unavailable. No profile was changed.';renderProfiles();return;}
    profileActionPending=true;renderProfiles();
    try{
      const result=locks.request('nfsu2-driving-tools-profiles-v1-write',execute);
      if(result&&typeof result.then==='function')result.catch(()=>{if(epoch===profileActionEpoch)profileNotice='Could not lock profile storage. No profile change was confirmed.';}).finally(()=>{if(epoch===profileActionEpoch){profileActionPending=false;renderProfiles();}});
      else {profileActionPending=false;renderProfiles();}
    }catch{profileActionPending=false;profileNotice='Could not lock profile storage. No profile change was confirmed.';renderProfiles();}
  }
  function performProfileAction(action,request){
    const selected=request.selection;
    try{
      if(!profileStore)throw Error('Profiles are unavailable.');
      if(action==='save'||action==='update'){
        if(action==='update'&&!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        const saved=profileStore.save({id:action==='update'?selected.id:null,revision:action==='update'?selected.revision:null,name:request.name,settings:request.settings,networkConsent:request.networkConsent});
        profileSelection=saved;profileNotice='Saved '+saved.name+' locally in this browser. This profile will not load on startup until explicitly enabled.';
      }else if(action==='load'){
        if(!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        applyToolProfile(profileStore.load(selected.id,selected.revision));return;
      }else if(action==='delete'){
        if(!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        profileStore.remove(selected.id,selected.revision);profileSelection=null;ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value='';ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=false;profileNotice='Saved profile deleted. Current controls are unchanged; automatic loading for it is off.';
      }else if(action==='auto'){
        const enabled=request.auto;
        if(enabled&&!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        profileStore.setAuto(enabled?selected.id:null,enabled?selected.revision:null);
        if(enabled){
          // Clear the fallback latch only AFTER the requested saved revision was
          // authorized successfully; a stale/failed enable must not erase Stop.
          try{sessionStorage.removeItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP);if(sessionStorage.getItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP)==='1')throw Error();}
          catch{try{profileStore.setAuto(null);}catch{}throw Error('Cannot clear the Stop pause in this tab. Automatic loading remains blocked here; check storage before retrying.');}
          profileSessionStopped=false;
        }
        profileNotice=enabled?'Load on startup enabled for '+selected.name+'. Its saved choices, including separately saved network permission, will be requested after reload. F9 pauses this.':'Automatic profile loading is off. Current controls are unchanged.';
      }
    }catch(error){profileNotice=error.message||'Profile action failed. Nothing was loaded.';message(profileNotice);}
    renderProfiles();
  }

# Hosted-race selection investigation and narrow prototype

## Result

The user asked for their own list of player-hosted races, repeating while AI drives only during races and releases in free roam. Quick Race is not that feature. The earlier `autonomous-races-candidate` is a separate solo prototype and must not be merged or described as hosted racing.

This isolated v0.31-based candidate implements **only a read-only nearby-card selector preview**. A player displays each nearby lobby with the game's existing next-lobby control and selects visible host/race text using checkboxes. The preview can watch for a selected visible card. It does not join, create, leave or start a lobby, drive, navigate, handle a dialog, claim a finish, change rewards or send a network message. It is not a global list. It makes no claim to uniquely identify a player from their displayed name.

No new release number or distributable ZIP has been created. This is an integration/research artifact, not fulfillment of the full autonomy request. Native driving, including Drag and Street X, remains v0.31 byte-for-byte. The independent race-only-AI worker owns the separately reviewed toggle; it is not merged here.

## Grounded interfaces

Inspected local source at `research/upstream`, commit `16b23865f09dc41b9533635180e6d3fd34c45a6d`. Static source mapping is not live verification of the deployed site/module.

### 1. Free-roam nearby lobbies

- `runtime/roam_game.c:5784`: `MP_JOIN_M = 15.f`. `mp_here` at 6237 includes only shown/allowed lobbies whose host is linked and whose start is within 15 m. The visible list is not all hosted events on the server.
- `runtime/roam_game.c:6208–6265`: eligibility and sorting, currently picked lobby, joinable checks. Native `MpLobby` includes identity internally. It is not an exported page API.
- `runtime/roam_game.c:7043–7121`: `mp_panel` sends one JSON card. It includes visible race kind/track/laps/stage, player names (host first), current view/status, page count/index, fee and other presentation fields. It does **not** include the native host/lobby/race identifiers.
- `web/src/app/lobby.ts`: the native JSON is private state in `LobbyPanel`; DOM `#lobby[data-v=join]`, `.lobby-race`, first `.lobby-pname`, and the first header `.ov-small` expose display text. `#lobby-cover` represents the game's transition view.
- `LobbyPanel.offers`: the page's next control sends LB_NEXT (1); New lobby is a distinct LB_NEW (5), never to be clicked as a fallback. The visual Join row has no click callback; it is a hint to press the game's Engage key.
- `runtime/roam_game.c:6505–6511`: `mp_engage_spot` calls `mp_joinable()` at action-handling time; **if none exists, it calls `mp_open` and hosts a new lobby**. A prior page snapshot does not make a later Enter safe.
- `runtime/roam_game.c:7299–7373`: an open career event uses `UI_EngageRaceDialog.fng`, then a custom two-button Solo/Multiplayer-or-Join question. The messages are `MSG_MP_SOLO = 0x4d505301`, `MSG_MP_MULTI = 0x4d505302`, `MSG_MP_BACK = 0x4d505303`. Button meaning/default changes depending on whether a lobby still exists. Blind Enter or generic dialog approval is unsafe.
- `runtime/roam_game.c:6568` and `web/src/app/friends.ts:700`: far joining uses actual friend invitations carrying host/lobby/race IDs. It is not a generic route around proximity/private/stage restrictions. This prototype does not intercept invitations or manufacture their parameters.
- `runtime/mprace.c`: after a normal join, the game already handles the trip through native LAN setup/readiness, race results and return to the career/free-roam location. It is preferable to let that existing flow own menus, rather than create another menu driver.

### 2. Native Online / LAN game browser

This is different from free-roam cards and does not imply a return-to-free-roam loop.

- `runtime/mprace.c:1427`: `find_game` reads `h = [0x86a858 + 8]`, count `[h + 0x14]`, array `[h + 0x40]`, pointers to records. A record of at least 0x1c0 bytes has host text at +0x38 (16 bytes) and game name at +4. The existing game code uses it to find a known LAN host. It is not yet a reviewed public extension adapter for arbitrary hosted selection.
- `runtime/lobbyclick.c`: `PC_OL_Lobby.fng` native UI selection; normal Join can show an unread-messages warning, then chooses the row selected **at confirmation time**. Source documents a historical wrong-row join caused by click-through, fixed in the native runtime.
- `runtime/olfilter.c`: native Online filters and their state; `web/server-rs/crates/online/src/lobby.rs`: public search results, private/active/password flags and list updates. No direct requests or credentials were used here.

If the intended UI is unclear, the smallest useful question is: “Are these the hosted race cards at a free-roam race start, or the Online Find Game list?” A screenshot of the list, with private chat hidden, can resolve that without requesting game-account data.

## Exact blockers to full selected hosted-race automation

1. **Stable identity and atomic action guard.** A join must target the user-selected native host/lobby/race identity. It must revalidate eligibility, range, open status and identity at execution time, and refuse if anything changed. No fallback to creating a lobby, joining another row or starting solo.
2. **List scope.** The current page shows only one eligible nearby card. Getting all map/server races, driving between race starts and responding to actual invitations are separate interfaces, not covered by this prototype. AI intentionally disabled in free roam would also rule out unattended travel between distant starts unless separately designed.
3. **Native dialog proof.** If normal input is retained, the precise card, selected native row, expected Join message and original identity must be correlated through every step. Current DOM text does not provide this correlation.
4. **Exact deployed-module adapter.** Mapping internal `g_mp` or injecting a guarded command needs symbol/signature evidence for each supported module. No offsets are guessed. A narrow native command should expose only current allowed offers and perform join-if-exactly-matches, with no reward/success writes.
5. **Live verification.** Test a consenting host and participant in a controlled lobby: selected Drag appears, disappears, changes host, becomes full/private, opens confirmation, starts, finishes, returns to roam and reappears. Check Stop/F7/F9, focus loss, server disconnect, module reload, an unexpected dialog and identity change mid-input. Do not claim completion, wins or stability from unit tests.

The action withheld is auto-joining/confirming a player-hosted lobby. It has not been attempted, denied or partially executed. No permission denial occurred. This is an implementation/verification blocker, not missing permission to proceed with a known-safe action.

## Candidate design and safety

`extension/hosted-race-list.js` is a separate observation/choice module. It reads only the existing nearby-card DOM and keeps a maximum 32 observed descriptors, at most 16 selected. Selection is session-memory only, with no storage, account inspection, network requests or socket interception. Previously seen choices explicitly say they may be unavailable. Missing/changed DOM, duplicates and stale observation produce waiting/unknown state, never input.

It is mounted inside the existing tool shadow tree so input controls remain within the tool's keyboard exclusion. It uses CSSStyleSheet/adoptedStyleSheets for the site's CSP rather than inline style elements. Text is assigned via textContent, not HTML. Unchanged observations retain checkbox elements/focus. F7, F9, main Stop/Manual buttons, hidden tab and blur stop watching; resume is explicit. Preview errors cannot prevent the original driving controls from mounting or stopping.

Changes to existing extension files: four small page.js integration additions (variable, Stop hook, Manual hook, mount hook); manifest name/description and one JS file entry. All other extension files match the frozen v0.31 baseline. No permission, host match, native AI, handling, force, input, save, score, reward or result modifications.

## Recommended integration order

1. Finish and review the independent race-only AI toggle on stable v0.31. Keep network opt-in, driver handback and Drag full-physics/GO gates. Do not promise that every native race AI can win.
2. Confirm which hosted interface the user means.
3. Review a stable identity/list adapter and native join-if-exactly-matches command. Keep the selected list by explicit host/event criteria, not by current row index. Bound retries and fail closed.
4. Add queue states: Off → waiting for selected eligible offer → join pending → waiting for host → game-owned transition → race (race-only AI owns driver) → return to roam → waiting. Stop must clear queued input and session ownership, never force a native race result or leave a race with a penalty without deliberate user action.
5. Only release the complete hosted loop after controlled live verification. The existing same-folder packaging builder can package a reviewed merged release; do not label this preview as autonomous streaming.

## Review follow-up

Independent review caught two preview-only UI issues: CSS-hidden/photo-mode cards were initially counted as visible, and checkbox replacement could drop keyboard focus. The implementation now checks effective element/ancestor visibility and retains keyed checkbox nodes across selection, watch-status and observation changes. Dedicated regression tests cover both. The candidate-only package script-list assertion was updated to include the new, explicitly reviewed observation module rather than weakening that assertion. Native baseline files remained untouched.

The preview browser test was not run successfully: Chromium failed to create its singleton socket within the current environment. CPU/DOM-fixture tests are not browser or gameplay proof.

Final local result: all 1,894 tests passed, including 21 focused selector tests. The independent reviewer approved only the narrow read-only prototype after the three findings were fixed. The manifest remains 0.31.0 deliberately; this is not a new release. The exact PC/UI view is being investigated separately because the user clarified that they can see lobbies; the nearby-card implementation must not be assumed to represent their intended list.

## Actual connected-PC check

A read-only inspection of the connected Windows PC's existing Chrome tab at https://nfsu2.xyz/ succeeded after the user said they can see lobbies. At that inspection, the current screen was an active solo Drag race, not a lobby list. The rendered HUD showed 1st/4, gear 5, 143 MPH, and the extension HUD reported “Solo - Drag,” “Native Drag AI active” and native custom pace paused. The accessibility tree exposed only the game image. No clicks, keys, race changes or settings changes were made. This supports only the current visible state, not a completed race, robust automation or the intended list. Next required input: have the user display the exact lobby list they mean, then inspect its actual rows/controls read-only.

test('combined power and grip stress does not compound through 5000 adjustments and exact restores',()=>{
 const f=performanceFixture(),physics=0xe18000,wheels=[0xe19000,0xe1a000,0xe1b000,0xe1c000];f.put(f.car+0x34,physics);
 wheels.forEach((w,i)=>{f.put(physics+0x38+i*4,w);f.d.setFloat32(w+0x188,1,true);});
 const base=f.read(0x230);
 for(let i=0;i<5000;i++){
  const s=f.e.state(),power=1+(i%21)/10,grip=1+(i%11)/10;
  f.e.tunePerformance(s,power,i%2===0);f.e.tuneGrip(s,grip);
  assert.equal(f.read(0x230),Math.fround(base*power));assert.equal(f.read(0x2dc),Math.fround(.5*power));assert.equal(f.read(0x2c0),i%2===0?0:150);
  wheels.forEach(w=>assert.equal(f.d.getFloat32(w+0x188,true),Math.fround(grip)));
  if(i%7===0){f.e.restorePerformance(s);f.e.restoreGrip(s);assert.equal(f.read(0x230),base);assert.equal(f.read(0x2dc),.5);wheels.forEach(w=>assert.equal(f.d.getFloat32(w+0x188,true),1));}
 }
 f.e.restorePerformance(f.e.state());f.e.restoreGrip(f.e.state());assert.equal(f.read(0x230),base);assert.equal(f.read(0x2c0),150);
});

  f.focus(true);
 }
 f.press('F9');assert.equal(f.read(0x2dc),.5);f.wheels.forEach(w=>assert.equal(f.d.getFloat32(w+0x188,true),1));

function interleaveBeforeCompare(e,action){const real=e.compareFloat.bind(e);let ran=false;e.compareFloat=(...args)=>{if(!ran){ran=true;action();}return real(...args);};return ()=>ran;}
test('apply and restore refuse a retired grip/ride identity immediately before a field operation',()=>{
 for(const type of ['power','grip'])for(const restoring of [false,true]){
  const f=type==='power'?performanceFixture():gripFixture(),s=f.e.state();
  const apply=()=>type==='power'?f.e.tunePerformance(s,1.5,true):f.e.tuneGrip(s,1.3);
  const restore=()=>type==='power'?f.e.restorePerformance(s):f.e.restoreGrip(s);
  if(restoring)apply();
  const retired=type==='power'?[...Array.from({length:9},(_,i)=>f.pi+0x230+i*4),f.pi+0x2dc,f.pi+0x2c0]:f.wheels.map(w=>w+0x188);
  const ran=interleaveBeforeCompare(f.e,()=>{f.put(f.car+(type==='power'?0x10:0x34),0xe80000);retired.forEach(p=>f.d.setFloat32(p,99,true));});
  restoring?restore():apply();assert(ran(),'interleaving was executed');retired.forEach(p=>assert.equal(f.d.getFloat32(p,true),99));
 }
});
test('compare-and-swap preserves another writer after the final ownership check',()=>{
 for(const restoring of [false,true]){
  const f=gripFixture(),s=f.e.state();if(restoring)f.e.tuneGrip(s,1.3);
  const real=f.e.compareFloat.bind(f.e);let ran=false;
  f.e.compareFloat=(p,expected,value,guard)=>real(p,expected,value,()=>{const result=guard();if(!ran){ran=true;f.d.setFloat32(p,.8,true);}return result;});
  restoring?f.e.restoreGrip(s):f.e.tuneGrip(s,1.3);assert(ran);assert.equal(f.read()[0],Math.fround(.8));assert.deepEqual(f.read().slice(1),[1,1,1]);
 }
});
test('partial adjustment rolls back only successful owned fields when another field changes',()=>{
 const f=performanceFixture(),s=f.e.state(),real=f.e.compareFloat.bind(f.e);let count=0,ran=false;
 f.e.compareFloat=(p,expected,value,guard)=>{if(++count===4){ran=true;f.d.setFloat32(p,.77,true);}return real(p,expected,value,guard);};
 assert.equal(f.e.tunePerformance(s,2,true).changed,true);assert(ran);assert.equal(f.read(0x230),Math.fround(.2));assert.equal(f.read(0x23c),Math.fround(.77));assert.equal(f.read(0x2dc),.5);assert.equal(f.e.performancePatch,null);
});

  const before=Buffer.from(f.memory.buffer);const result=type==='power'?f.e.tunePerformance(s,1.5,true):type==='grip'?f.e.tuneGrip(s,1.3):f.e.refill(s);

 }
});

test('unchanged power and grip factors avoid repeat atomic stores',()=>{
 const f=performanceFixture(),g=gripFixture(),s=f.e.state(),t=g.e.state();f.e.tunePerformance(s,2,true);g.e.tuneGrip(t,1.5);
 const original=Atomics.compareExchange;let count=0;Atomics.compareExchange=(...args)=>{count++;return original(...args);};
 try{for(let i=0;i<50;i++){f.e.tunePerformance(s,2,true);g.e.tuneGrip(t,1.5);}}finally{Atomics.compareExchange=original;}
 assert.equal(count,0);
});

// Named tool profiles use the real page and the same guarded game-memory harness.
const Profiles=require('../extension/tool-profiles.js');
const profileRecord=f=>JSON.parse(f.profileStorage.get(Profiles.KEY));
function saveToolProfile(f,name='My driving',consent=false){f.input('profile-name',name);f.change('profile-network',consent);f.click('profile-save');return profileRecord(f).profiles.at(-1);}
function chooseToolProfile(f,profile){f.change('profile-select',profile.id);}
const fullProfileCaps={legacy:true,ai:true,pace:true,corner:true,walls:true,cars:true,dyno:true,dragAI:true,onlineTraffic:true,onlinePlayers:true,nativeDragOverheat:true};

test('named tool profiles survive a browser restart but never autoload by default',async()=>{
 const first=await pageFixture(null,true,true,{capabilities:fullProfileCaps});
 for(const id of ['ai','nos','drag','drag-no-blowout','boost','grip','walls','cars','traffic','players','online','tester','dyno-enable'])first.change(id,true);
 first.input('power','2.1');first.input('rpm','7400');first.change('dyno-goal','peakTorque');
 const p=saveToolProfile(first,'Everything');assert.equal(p.settings.dynoEnabled,true);assert.equal(p.settings.dynoGoal,'peakTorque');assert.equal(p.settings.dragNoBlowout,true);assert.equal(p.networkConsent,false);assert.equal(profileRecord(first).auto,null);
 const restarted=await pageFixture(null,true,true,{profileStorage:first.profileStorage,capabilities:fullProfileCaps});
 for(const id of ['ai','nos','drag','boost','grip','walls','cars','online','dyno-enable'])assert.equal(restarted.nodes[id].checked,false,id);
 chooseToolProfile(restarted,p);restarted.click('profile-load');
 for(const id of ['ai','nos','drag','drag-no-blowout','boost','grip','walls','cars','tester','dyno-enable'])assert.equal(restarted.nodes[id].checked,true,id);
 for(const id of ['online','traffic','players'])assert.equal(restarted.nodes[id].checked,false,id);
 assert.equal(restarted.nodes.power.value,2.1);assert.equal(restarted.nodes.rpm.value,7400);assert.equal(restarted.nodes['dyno-goal'].value,'peakTorque');
 assert.equal(restarted.dynoLog.finds,0);assert.equal(restarted.dynoLog.applies,0);assert.equal(restarted.dynoLog.restores,0);
 assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(p),/"car"|baseline|draft|applied|diagnostic|memory|pointer/);
});
test('manual profile loading never borrows network permission from current controls or unsaved checkbox',async()=>{
 const f=await pageFixture(null,true,false,{capabilities:fullProfileCaps});
 for(const id of ['online','traffic','players','ai'])f.change(id,true);

function uiFixture() {
  const f = fixture(), win = new Element('window'), container = new Element('shadow');
  win.performance = { now: () => win.time }; win.time = 0; win.CSSStyleSheet = class { replaceSync(text) { this.text = text; } };
  win.setInterval = callback => { win.poll = callback; return 1; }; win.clearInterval = id => { win.cleared = id; };
  const controller = mount(f.doc, win, container), host = container.children[0], shadow = host.shadow;
  const buttons = shadow.querySelectorAll('button');
  const select = () => { const check = shadow.querySelector('input'); check.checked = true; check.fire('change'); };
  return { ...f, win, container, controller, host, shadow, buttons, select };
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, zipfile
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = root / 'extension'
manifest = json.loads((source / 'manifest.json').read_text())
assert manifest['version'] == '0.31.0'
folder = 'NFSU2-Driving-Tools-v0.31.0'
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path)
args = parser.parse_args()
out = args.output or root.parent / 'NFSU2-Driving-Tools-v0.31-Combined-Drag-Retention.zip'
files = ['README.md', 'CHANGELOG.md', 'manifest.json', 'popup.html', *manifest['content_scripts'][0]['js']]
assert len(files) == len(set(files))
assert sorted(files) == sorted(p.name for p in source.iterdir() if p.is_file())
assert all((source / p).is_file() for p in files)
assert manifest['content_scripts'][0]['matches'] == ['https://nfsu2.xyz/*']
assert manifest['content_scripts'][0]['world'] == 'MAIN'
# Exclusive creation keeps any previously delivered archive immutable.
with zipfile.ZipFile(out, 'x', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9) as z:
    for name in files:
        # Canonical metadata makes the same reviewed sources reproduce the same ZIP.
        entry = zipfile.ZipInfo(folder + '/' + name, date_time=(1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
        entry.create_system = 3
        entry.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16
        entry.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        z.writestr(entry, (source / name).read_bytes(), compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9)
with zipfile.ZipFile(out) as z:
    assert z.testzip() is None
    assert len(z.namelist()) == len(files)
    for name in files:
        assert z.read(folder + '/' + name) == (source / name).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({'path': str(out), 'size': out.stat().st_size, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'files': files}, indent=2))
